result.instruction: In `fir16_sym_core`, change only the `result5` saturation logic: detect signed 17-bit overflow with `rounded4[16] != rounded4[15]`, select positive or negative saturation from the sign bit, and otherwise pass through `rounded4[15:0]`. Preserve the existing five-slot enables, registered output, reset behavior, and `// @latency 5`; do not change the arithmetic or handshake pipeline. Treat any LUT reduction as unproven until routed metrics show a strict LUT improvement over the incumbent, with all deterministic gates passing and WNS and WHS remaining nonnegative.
